Below are the recommended cut-off dates by which to order from our shop to ensure delivery in time for 25th December. Please do get your orders in early! And remember all proceeds go directly back into supporting the project. 👍

Looking for a single date to remember? Unless you’re sending a framed print to the US, order by Monday 23 November and everything should arrive in time, wherever you are. US framed prints need to be ordered by end of Monday 16th November!
